_comment: **The biome is the gate, for now.** An abyss only exists where the sea is deep enough, so placing this
in the abyss biome already confines it to the Ages the material is meant for. What it does NOT yet
check is the deluge, which design SS7.1.2 makes the material's second gate -- so this is over-generous
until `EarlyGameRareMaterials` grows an entry for it and takes the placement over.
`OCEAN_FLOOR_WG` and a closing `biome` filter are the whalefall's arrangement and for its reason: the
filter re-checks the biome at the chosen column, so a sea bed that pokes above the abyss line gets
nothing. The feature re-reads the heightmap itself as well, because it has to know the floor to build
UNWALKED. The rarity is the first dial: one chunk in 32 puts a vent within a few hundred blocks of
wherever a diver goes down, which may well be too many for a landmark.
